parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 1 (CHEMBL4235). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL4235 and standard_type IC50, and require docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
